title: Requests
viaLinkerdViz: Read from the Prometheus of linkerd-viz.

scope.istio: Requests the Istio proxies of these pods received.
scope.linkerd: Requests the Linkerd proxies of these pods received; failures as Linkerd classifies them.
scope.ingressNginx: Only requests that came through ingress-nginx to the Services that select these pods.
scope.beyla: Requests Grafana Beyla saw these pods serve.
scope.hubble: Requests Cilium Hubble saw reach these pods.

noRequestsNow: No requests in the last 5 minutes.
noErrorsWithoutRequests: No requests to count errors of.
noLatency: This source has no latency histogram.

chart.errors: Failed requests per second, last hour

failed: Could not read the metrics of {{sources}}.
noPrometheus: Request metrics and CPU throttling are read from Prometheus, and none is set up or found for this cluster.
noSource: Prometheus has no request metrics: none of Istio, Linkerd, ingress-nginx, Grafana Beyla or Cilium Hubble is reporting to it.
wouldProvide: Any of these would provide them: an Istio mesh, a Linkerd mesh with linkerd-viz (or a Prometheus that scrapes its proxies), ingress-nginx with its metrics scraped, Grafana Beyla, or Cilium Hubble with HTTP metrics enabled.
noDataHere: Prometheus has metrics of {{sources}}, but none for these pods.

throttling.title: CPU throttling
throttling.about: Share of CPU periods each container was throttled in over the last hour.
throttling.unknown: CPU throttling could not be read from Prometheus.
throttling.none: Prometheus has no CPU throttling counters for these containers.
throttling.limitCause: Throttled in {{percent}} of CPU periods with a CPU limit of {{limit}}: the limit is the likely cause of slow responses.
throttling.suggested: Right-sizing suggests a CPU limit of {{limit}} from its usage history.
throttling.seeRightsizing: The Right-sizing section suggests a limit once it has enough usage history.

linkerdViz: linkerd-viz is installed: the success rate, request rate and latency of these pods are in the Requests section.
